title: The Best Zigbee Smart Locks
subtitle: Zigbee deadbolts and conversion kits, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: Zigbee locks are mostly Kwikset's Zigbee 3.0 models and Aqara's hub-based locks. We pulled what's selling on Amazon and scored it on rating, review volume, and features.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.q: Will a smart lock fit my door?
buyers_guide.a: Most smart deadbolts fit a standard US door with a 2-1/8 in. bore hole and a 2-3/8 or 2-3/4 in. backset. Retrofit locks like Level Bolt replace only the inside parts and keep your existing key and hardware.

buyers_guide.q: What happens if the batteries die?
buyers_guide.a: Locks warn you in their app before the batteries run out. Most also have a backup key, an emergency power point, or both. Check the listing for which one yours has.

Look for encrypted radios (Z-Wave S2, Matter, Thread, or the maker's encrypted Bluetooth), auto-lock, and an activity log. ANSI/BHMA grade ratings describe physical strength; Grade 2 or better is typical for a front door.
